title: Vault: feedback toast when a card is pinned
acceptance: Pinning a card (roster tile or secret tile) shows a toast 'Pinned to Favourites' with an Undo action; unpinning shows none (tests in players.index.test.tsx)
Undo from the toast unpins that same card and the card returns to its shelf (test)
Existing pin behaviour is unchanged: the card still moves to Favourites, storage keys unchanged, star stays 44px, roles/labels used by e2e/favourites.spec.ts unchanged
Toast copy is generic: no names, counts or set information
A vault-pinned scene exists in e2e/factory-shots.spec.ts so the before/after shows the toast
Before/after screenshots committed under shots/review/ and described from the images themselves
